summary.text: Andrea Valderrama is a Democratic state representative from Oregon House District 47 in Outer East Portland who has served since April 1, 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Andrea Valderrama graduated from Willamette High School in 2007, earned a B.A. in political science and Romance languages from the University of Oregon in 2011, and earned an M.P.A. from Portland State University in 2018.

Her career experience includes working as policy director of the ACLU of Oregon, advocacy director of the Coalition of Communities of Color, and an outreach and policy advisor with the City of Portland.
In the 2023-2024 legislative term, Ballotpedia lists Valderrama as a member of the House Education, House Rules and Joint Ways and Means committees.
